All Thumbs.description: Transfers inventory items slowly. Can't craft anything while walking. Slower rope climbing speed, and higher chance of falling. Slower weapon shouldering time.

Artisan.description: Better at pottery and glass crafts.

Athletic.description: Faster running speed. Can run for longer without tiring.

Blacksmith Knowledge.description: Can use an anvil to create metal items.

Bushcrafter.description: Can find medicinal herbs and craft medicines and poultices from them, and make simple stone and bone tools.   Start fires faster.

Claustrophobic.description: Gets panicked when in small indoor rooms.

Conspicuous.description: More likely to be spotted by zombies.

Crafty.description: Increased XP gains for Crafting skills.

Desensitized.description: Far less prone to panic.  Ignore discomfort.

Dextrous.description: Transfers inventory items quickly. Faster rope climbing speed, and less chance of falling. Faster weapon shouldering time.

Disorganized.description: Decreased container inventory capacity. Affects world containers and bags, but not your main inventory.

Eagle Eyed.description: Faster visibility fade. Higher visibility arc. Weapon sights more effective at long range.

Fast Metabolism.description: Permanent tendency to lose weight. Starts with Low Weight trait.

Fast Reader.description: Takes less time to read books.

Fear of Blood.description: Panic when performing first aid on self. Cannot perform first aid on others. Gets stressed when bloody.

Hard of Hearing.description: Smaller perception radius. Smaller hearing range.

Illiterate.description: Cannot read any books or in-world text.

Inconspicuous.description: Less likely to be spotted by zombies.

Iron Gut.description: Less chance to have food illness.

Marksman.description: Improved gun accuracy and damage. Quicker reload.

Mason.description: Better at building stone and brick constructions.

Nutritionist.description: Can see the nutritional values of any food.

Outdoorsy.description: Less affected by harsh weather conditions.

Prone to Illness.description: More prone to disease. Faster rate of zombification.

Puny.description: Far less knockback from melee weapons. Extremely small carrying weight.

Restless Sleeper.description: Slow loss of tiredness while sleeping.

Short Sighted.description: Smaller view distance. Slower visibility fade. Weapon sights less effective.

Slow Healer.description: Recovers slowly from injuries and illness.

Slow Metabolism.description: Permanent tendency to gain weight. Starts with High Weight trait.

Slow Reader.description: Takes longer to read books and other literature.

Smoker.description: Unhappiness rises when tobacco is not smoked. Stress and unhappiness decrease after smoking tobacco.

Stout.description: Extra knockback from melee weapons. Increased carrying weight.

Strong.description: Extra knockback from melee weapons. Increased carrying weight.

Thin-skinned.description: Higher chance of being scratched or bitten by zombies.

Unfit.description: Very low endurance and endurance regeneration.

Vehicle Knowledge.description: Has knowledge of common and commercial vehicle models, and repairs.

Weak.description: Less knockback from melee weapons. Decreased carrying weight.

Weak Stomach.description: Higher chance to have food illness.

Whittler.description: Can carve wood and bone items.
